items.quote: All measurements of the formation enthalpy of measured alloys were performed in a protective argon atmosphere with the use of a drop calorimeter and alumina crucibles.
A Bruker D8 Discover diffractometer with CoKα radiation was used to study the phase compositions of the prepared powder samples.

The electromotive force measurements for the alloys from the Ge-Li system were conducted using the concentration cell method, the scheme of which is as follows: Reference electrode | electrolyte with Li + | alloy electrode.

These alloys were prepared in a glove box with a protective high purity argon atmosphere (H2O < 0.5 ppm, O2 < 0.1 ppm, N2 < 1 ppm). The weighted amounts of metals were melted in a resistance furnace in tantalum crucibles. After melting and careful stirring, the liquid alloys were poured into a specially designed steel ingot mold.
